title: SEC 40-80kW Integrated Charger
description: Discover the SEC 40–80kW Integrated Charger by Energy Savers: scalable, high-efficiency DC fast charging with modular design for flexible deployment.

blocks.text: Sinexcel SEC 80kW charger is equipped with 2 DC charging connectors, which supports the output at a maximum of 1000V and 80kW full power. In order to charge for more EVs at the same time, an Type 2 connector with 22kW is optional to realize this purpose. It is suitable to various charging scenarios and also meet most of EVs’ charging needs in the market.

Ultra wide output
voltage & high efficiency

Output voltage 200-1000V, Constant output voltage 300-1000V.
Support high power charging and can output at 80kW continuously.
Compatible with all EVs in the market and meet future demands.
Equipped with Sinexcel self-developed power module, SEC 80kW can output at a peak efficiency of 96%, which can reduce the power consumption and save the cost thus realize the max profit.

The SEC 80kW charging system is designed to support a maximum output power of 80kW, ensuring a faster charging rate and an enhanced user experience. Its modular design allows simultaneous charging, with power distribution equally allocated to each connector for flexible power configuration. Equipped with a Sinexcel 20kW power module, this DC charging system offers high efficiency and optimal power utilization. The 40-80kW flexible configuration supports customization and seamless upgrades by adding additional power modules. As a Siemens System Integrator in Dubai, we ensure top-tier integration solutions for efficient and reliable charging infrastructure, meeting the growing demands of the EV industry.
Modular design for easy installation and maintenance
SEC 80kW adopts function modular design, which makes it convenient to produce, install and maintain.
